shots.S1: A wide establishing shot of a small pottery workshop. Shelves of unglazed bowls and a wooden workbench. No teapot visible. Slow camera pan. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.

shots.S6: A clean white glazed ceramic teapot sits beside a white cup on a wooden table in a pottery workshop. A hand gently rotates the teapot. Close-up. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.
